description:
Priority: P0 | Area: sandbox | Labels: fix,P0,area:sandbox | Milestone: v0.1.0 | Task: CTX-XXXX

Fixes review finding PHO-002 (the resource-control gap), part 1 of 2 (part 2 = T7 memory quota).

## Problem
The executor charges fixed costs on callback entry and sequence step, then checks Fuel only after control returns (thread/executor.rs:292-297,360-364,457-523). New string/pattern/utf8 callbacks discard the Execution argument and cannot charge proportionally:
- string.format, string.rep, string.pack/unpack: stdlib/string.rs:118-278, stdlib/string/{format,pack,unpack}.rs
- pattern search + gsub result construction: stdlib/string/patterns.rs:106-247,249-447
- utf8 scans/iteration: stdlib/utf8.rs:49-313
gsub grows a Rust String with no global output ceiling; format and utf8 loop/allocate without a global quota. Local 16 MiB caps (rep/pack/load) are operation-specific.

## Required work
1. Audit EVERY variable-cost callback in stdlib (string, patterns, utf8, base, load, table as applicable) and give each a deterministic byte/item cost model consumed from Execution::fuel.
2. Convert operations that can exceed a wall slice into resumable Sequences (yield on Fuel exhaustion, preserve state), or prove each operation is bounded below the slice and document the bound.
3. Enforce checked output caps on all growing buffers (gsub, format, utf8 assembly) independent of the T7 global quota.
4. Add LOW-LIMIT tests (small fuel budgets) that prove interruption occurs mid-operation and state is preserved and resumable, without large stress inputs.
5. Update docs/specifications/sandbox-and-fuel.md and modular-stdlib.md to state the real cost model; do not overclaim.

## Acceptance criteria
- Every callback either consumes proportional Fuel or is proven constant-bounded with a documented justification.
- Low-limit interruption/resumption tests pass.
- A hostile gsub/format/utf8 case is stopped by Fuel with no allocation blowup.
- Independent reviewer APPROVE; just check green.

## Deliverable
PR with cost model, code changes, tests, doc updates.
title: T5 fix(fuel): proportional Fuel accounting for variable-cost stdlib callbacks

Fixes review finding PHO-001 (Phase 2 gap).

## Problem
No require, package.searchers, package.preload, or capability-rooted VFS exists (source search returns nothing). Bitty's plugin VM contract requires a rooted module model.

## Spec
Implement docs/specifications/module-resolver.md exactly:
- require execution pipeline with package.loaded cache (lua 5.4 semantics).
- Pluggable searcher chain (ModuleSearcher trait) in order: preload -> embedded -> VFS -> custom host.
- package.preload table for core built-ins.
- Capability-constrained VFS bound to a virtual namespace/root; path normalization (a.b.c -> a/b/c.lua or a/b/c/init.lua); traversal prevention rejecting .., ./, leading /, drive/UNC escapes BEFORE resolution.
- Circular dependency handling via sentinel true.
- Empty default package.path; no package.loadlib / native searchers.

## Required work
1. Implement the runtime + tests. No hardcoded host paths; roots are injected by the host.
2. Follow T5 cost discipline: resolution and loader execution consume proportional Fuel.
3. Tests: VFS traversal rejected (require('../../../etc/passwd')); circular require terminates; preload resolves without FS; missing module error lists search candidates.
4. Update docs/specifications/module-resolver.md implementation_status and docs/README.md status; update COMPATIBILITY.md require row.

## Acceptance criteria
- All spec verification-plan tests pass.
- No host OS path is reachable outside registered roots.
- Independent reviewer APPROVE; just check green.

PR implementing Phase 2 with tests and synced docs.

Fixes review finding PHO-002 (resource-control gap), part 2 of 2. Prerequisite for T8.

## Problem
Memory is measured (Lua::total_memory, lua.rs:224-229) but never refused at the allocator boundary. The documented RuntimeBuilder::fuel_limit / memory_limit API does not exist. Bitty RC-2 cannot be enforced because output can overshoot before the host observes it.

## Spec
Implement docs/specifications/sandbox-and-fuel.md section 4.2:
- MemoryLimit { max_bytes, current_bytes } enforced before every allocation/reallocation in the GC heap.
- On exceed: attempt incremental GC; if still insufficient, return Err(RuntimeError::OutOfMemory).
- No panics, no VM corruption; frames/tables/threads consistent; pcall can catch OOM if recovery memory remains.

## Required work
1. Implement allocator-side hard quota integrated with gc-arena metrics (see docs/architecture/gc-strategy.md).
2. Introduce the builder API: RuntimeBuilder::fuel_limit(n) and RuntimeBuilder::memory_limit(bytes) (these are named in the spec as acceptance criteria; implement the real API, do not just document).
3. Checked arithmetic for quota math; clean OutOfMemory error type.
4. Tests: 8 MiB quota + large string array allocation -> clean OOM error, no abort; pcall recovery path; state consistency after OOM; low-limit tests proving refusal (not just measurement).
5. Update sandbox-and-fuel.md implementation_status and docs/README.md; gc-strategy.md quota section.

## Acceptance criteria
- Spec verification-plan tests (infinite loop interrupted; replenishment resumes; memory ceiling clean OOM) pass.
- Zero native panics when scripts exceed bounds.
- Independent reviewer APPROVE; just check green.

## Deliverable
PR implementing Phase 3 with tests and synced docs.
title: T7 feat(sandbox): hard allocator memory quota with OOM recovery (Phase 3)

Fixes review finding PHO-001 (Phase 4 gap).

## Problem
Piccolo's NOOP waker remains (async_callback.rs:336-406,517-526). No HostOp type, no typed pending handle. A foreign future cannot wake/resume through the proposed host ABI.

## Spec
Implement docs/specifications/async-trampoline.md exactly:
- HostOpHandle(u64) opaque handle.
- SequencePoll::Suspend(handle) suspension; SequencePoll::Pending semantics.
- executor returns ExecutionResult::Suspended(handle) without unwinding native frames.
- executor.resume_host_op(ctx, handle, return_values) and executor.cancel_host_op(ctx, handle, msg).
- Zero tokio/async-std/smol dependency in the VM core (invariant).
- GC isolation: no Gc<'gc,T> held by the external future across a pending op.
- HostOpHandle finalizer notifies host to drop the future when the coroutine is collected/closed.

## Required work
1. Implement the typed bridge replacing the NOOP waker path. Keep the core synchronous and stackless.
2. Tests: mock async timer completes after 50ms -> script suspends, host advances, resumes with correct values (deterministic mock, no real sleep dependency in CI); cancellation surfaces as catchable pcall error; concurrent suspension of many coroutines completes non-blocking.
3. Update api-adjacent docs and sandbox-and-fuel cancellation policy; docs/README.md async status.

## Acceptance criteria
- Spec verification-plan tests pass deterministically.
- cargo tree proves no host async runtime dependency in phodopus core.
- Independent reviewer APPROVE; just check green.

## Deliverable
PR implementing Phase 4 with tests and synced docs.
title: T8 feat(async): typed HostOp host-async suspension bridge (Phase 4)
